regime_context: The detector shows Big Banks as the dominant narrative in a durable, broad-based uptrend, though crowded. Rotation is broad (69% eligible) and not one-narrative; the absolute-trend gate has proven risk-control value for Canada, so eligibility is a useful filter.
emerging_watch: Base Metals & Copper: Rank 3, eligible, low crowding, but durability bar only 0.49 and breadth 0.22. Watch for durability to cross 0.60 and breadth to expand above 0.50, which could signal a durable challenger. theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks exhibit the strongest trend-health combination (trending, durability 0.75, full breadth) and remain eligible under the validated absolute-trend gate. Crowding signals a sizing cap, not a reversal. Overweight while monitoring durability fade.
evidence: Rank #1, eligible true, durability_bar 0.75, hurst_tag 'trend', breadth 1.0
Gate_helps true – absolute trend gate materially reduced drawdown/volatility in historical backtests for this market
Crowded flag (crowding_z 1.17) – consistent with a discipline of capping, not fading
theses.dissent: Elevated crowding and a fully-priced rate-sensitive sector could suffer a sharp reversal if rate expectations shift abruptly; the detector does not forecast returns.

falsifier.text: If the theme's durability bar falls below 0.50 AND breadth contracts below 0.70 on a weekly closing basis, or if ZEB.TO closes below its 50-day simple moving average for three consecutive trading days.

theses.subject: REITs
theses.thesis: REITs are eligible (pass absolute trend), but their deeply negative momentum rank and mixed hurst regime suggest they will lag the broad market and the leading themes. Underweight expresses a relative-performance cautious view.
evidence: Eligible true – absolute trend intact, but relative momentum rank is a focus lens, not a return forecast
Gate_helps true – trend discipline still argues against overweight on a laggard even if it escapes a full-avoid
theses.dissent: If bond yields fall sharply or rotation into yield-sensitive sectors intensifies, REITs could rally despite weak rank; the detector is coincident.

falsifier.text: If REITs' rank rises into the top half (rank ≤6) and its durability bar stays above 0.65 on weekly closes for two consecutive weeks.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners are ineligible (below absolute trend gate), with near-zero breadth and a negative momentum rank. The validated risk-control gate advises avoiding such themes to limit drawdown.
evidence: Hurst_tag 'trend' likely indicates a downtrend – not a contrarian entry signal
Gate_helps true – excluding ineligible themes would have historically improved risk outcomes
theses.dissent: A sharp gold price spike triggered by a geopolitical surprise could rapidly restore trend and eligibility; the avoid call would be turned off if that materialises.

falsifier.text: If Gold Miners becomes eligible (score turns positive and remains eligible for five consecutive trading days) and its durability bar rises above 0.60.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
